baseline_core_source_lf:
\ Original declared S-DSP sample-boundary model. No CPU/ROM/SDK/real I/O.
DECIMAL
S" examples/snes-gauss.fs" INCLUDED
32000 CONSTANT SD-RATE 1024000 CONSTANT SD-CLOCK
CREATE SD-REGS 128 ALLOT CREATE SD-ARAM 65536 ALLOT
\ Per voice: on,pos,nibble,header,previous,older,phase,env,mode,delay,hist0..3.
CREATE SD-VOICES 112 CELLS ALLOT
0 CONSTANT SD-ON 1 CONSTANT SD-POS 2 CONSTANT SD-NIB 3 CONSTANT SD-HEADER
4 CONSTANT SD-P1 5 CONSTANT SD-P2 6 CONSTANT SD-PHASE 7 CONSTANT SD-ENV
8 CONSTANT SD-MODE 9 CONSTANT SD-DELAY
CREATE SD-RATES 0 , 2048 , 1536 , 1280 , 1024 , 768 , 640 , 512 ,
384 , 320 , 256 , 192 , 160 , 128 , 96 , 80 , 64 , 48 , 40 , 32 ,
24 , 20 , 16 , 12 , 10 , 8 , 6 , 5 , 4 , 3 , 2 , 1 ,
VARIABLE SD-CYCLE VARIABLE SD-DIV VARIABLE SD-FRAME VARIABLE SD-PENDING
VARIABLE SD-NOISE VARIABLE SD-EOFF VARIABLE SD-ELEN VARIABLE SD-EHI
VARIABLE SD-LEFT VARIABLE SD-RIGHT
CREATE SD-EHIST 16 CELLS ALLOT CREATE SD-MIX 2 CELLS ALLOT CREATE SD-EMIX 2 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE SD-EVENTS 3072 CELLS ALLOT VARIABLE SD-EVENT-COUNT VARIABLE SD-EVENT-INDEX
: SD-ASR { n bits -- q } n S>D 1 bits LSHIFT FM/MOD SWAP DROP ;
: SD-S8 255 AND DUP 128 AND IF 256 - THEN ;
: SD-S15 32767 AND DUP 16384 AND IF 32768 - THEN ;
: SD-S16 65535 AND DUP 32768 AND IF 65536 - THEN ;
: SD-SAT -32768 MAX 32767 MIN ;
: SD-V@ { v field -- n } v 14 * field + CELLS SD-VOICES + @ ;
: SD-V! { n v field -- } n v 14 * field + CELLS SD-VOICES + ! ;
: SD-R@ SD-REGS + C@ ;
: SD-B@ 65535 AND SD-ARAM + C@ ;
: SD-B! 65535 AND SD-ARAM + C! ;
: SD-W@ { a -- n } a SD-B@ a 1+ SD-B@ 8 LSHIFT OR ;
: SD-W! { n a -- } n 255 AND a SD-B! n 8 RSHIFT 255 AND a 1+ SD-B! ;
: SD-RESET ( -- )
  SD-REGS 128 0 FILL SD-ARAM 65536 0 FILL SD-VOICES 112 CELLS 0 FILL
  8 0 DO 3 I SD-MODE SD-V! LOOP 224 108 SD-REGS + C!
  0 SD-CYCLE ! 0 SD-DIV ! 0 SD-FRAME ! 0 SD-PENDING ! 16384 SD-NOISE !
  0 SD-EOFF ! 4 SD-ELEN ! 0 SD-EHI ! 0 SD-LEFT ! 0 SD-RIGHT !
  SD-EHIST 16 CELLS 0 FILL SD-MIX 2 CELLS 0 FILL SD-EMIX 2 CELLS 0 FILL
  0 SD-EVENT-COUNT ! 0 SD-EVENT-INDEX ! ;
: SD-BRR { nibble header old older | n shift f -- sample }
  nibble 8 >= IF nibble 16 - ELSE nibble THEN TO n
  header 4 RSHIFT TO shift header 2 RSHIFT 3 AND TO f
  shift 12 <= IF n 1 shift LSHIFT * 1 SD-ASR ELSE n 0< IF -2048 ELSE 0 THEN THEN TO n
  f CASE
    1 OF n old + old NEGATE 4 SD-ASR + TO n ENDOF
    2 OF n old 2 * + old -3 * 5 SD-ASR + older - older 4 SD-ASR + TO n ENDOF
    3 OF n old 2 * + old -13 * 6 SD-ASR + older - older 3 * 4 SD-ASR + TO n ENDOF
  ENDCASE n SD-SAT SD-S15 ;
: SD-DIR-ADDR { v -- addr } 93 SD-R@ 256 * v 16 * 4 + SD-R@ 4 * + 65535 AND ;
: SD-START { v -- }
  TRUE v SD-ON SD-V! v SD-DIR-ADDR SD-W@ v SD-POS SD-V!
  0 v SD-NIB SD-V! 0 v SD-HEADER SD-V! 0 v SD-P1 SD-V! 0 v SD-P2 SD-V!
  0 v SD-PHASE SD-V! 0 v SD-ENV SD-V! 0 v SD-MODE SD-V! 5 v SD-DELAY SD-V!
  4 0 DO 0 v 10 I + SD-V! LOOP
  124 SD-R@ 1 v LSHIFT INVERT AND 124 SD-REGS + C! ;
: SD-CONSUME { v | nib pos header b value -- }
  v SD-NIB SD-V@ TO nib v SD-POS SD-V@ TO pos
  nib 0= IF pos SD-B@ v SD-HEADER SD-V! THEN v SD-HEADER SD-V@ TO header
  pos 1+ nib 2 / + SD-B@ TO b
  nib 1 AND IF b 15 AND ELSE b 4 RSHIFT THEN header v SD-P1 SD-V@ v SD-P2 SD-V@ SD-BRR TO value
  v SD-P1 SD-V@ v SD-P2 SD-V! value v SD-P1 SD-V!
  3 0 DO v 11 I + SD-V@ v 10 I + SD-V! LOOP value v 13 SD-V!
  nib 1+ TO nib nib 16 = IF
    0 TO nib header 1 AND IF
      124 SD-R@ 1 v LSHIFT OR 124 SD-REGS + C!
      v SD-DIR-ADDR 2 + SD-W@ TO pos
      header 2 AND 0= IF 0 v SD-ENV SD-V! 3 v SD-MODE SD-V! THEN
    ELSE pos 9 + 65535 AND TO pos THEN
  THEN nib v SD-NIB SD-V! pos v SD-POS SD-V! ;
: SD-RATE? { rate -- flag } rate 0= IF FALSE EXIT THEN SD-FRAME @ rate CELLS SD-RATES + @ MOD 0= ;
: SD-ENV-PHASE { v | level -- }
  v SD-ENV SD-V@ TO level
  v SD-MODE SD-V@ 0= level 2016 >= AND IF 1 v SD-MODE SD-V! THEN
  v SD-MODE SD-V@ 1 = level v 16 * 6 + SD-R@ 5 RSHIFT 1+ 256 * <= AND IF 2 v SD-MODE SD-V! THEN ;
: SD-ENV-STEP { v | env mode a b gain rate delta -- }
  v SD-ENV SD-V@ TO env v SD-MODE SD-V@ TO mode
  mode 3 = IF env 8 - 0 MAX v SD-ENV SD-V! EXIT THEN
  v 16 * 5 + SD-R@ TO a v 16 * 6 + SD-R@ TO b v 16 * 7 + SD-R@ TO gain
  a 128 AND IF
    mode CASE
      0 OF a 15 AND 2 * 1+ TO rate a 15 AND 15 = IF 1024 ELSE 32 THEN TO delta ENDOF
      1 OF a 4 RSHIFT 7 AND 2 * 16 + TO rate env 255 + 256 / NEGATE TO delta ENDOF
      2 OF b 31 AND TO rate env 255 + 256 / NEGATE TO delta ENDOF
    ENDCASE
    rate SD-RATE? IF env delta + TO env THEN
  ELSE
    gain 128 AND 0= IF gain 127 AND 16 * TO env ELSE
      gain 31 AND SD-RATE? IF
        gain 5 RSHIFT 3 AND CASE
          0 OF env 32 - TO env ENDOF
          1 OF env env 255 + 256 / - TO env ENDOF
          2 OF env 32 + TO env ENDOF
          3 OF env env 1536 < IF 32 ELSE 8 THEN + TO env ENDOF
        ENDCASE
      THEN
    THEN
  THEN env 0 MAX 2047 MIN v SD-ENV SD-V! v SD-ENV-PHASE ;
: SD-GAUSS-SAMPLE { v | phase sum coefficient -- sample }
  v SD-PHASE SD-V@ 4 RSHIFT 255 AND TO phase 0 TO sum
  4 0 DO
    I CASE 0 OF 255 phase - ENDOF 1 OF 511 phase - ENDOF
      2 OF 256 phase + ENDOF 3 OF phase ENDOF ENDCASE
    CELLS SD-GAUSS + @ TO coefficient
    I 3 = IF sum SD-S16 TO sum THEN
    sum v 10 I + SD-V@ coefficient * 10 SD-ASR + TO sum
  LOOP sum SD-SAT 1 SD-ASR ;
: SD-PUBLISH { value v -- }
  v SD-ENV SD-V@ 4 RSHIFT v 16 * 8 + SD-REGS + C!
  value 7 SD-ASR 255 AND v 16 * 9 + SD-REGS + C! ;
: SD-VOICE { v previous | value pitch phase -- sample }
  v SD-ON SD-V@ 0= IF 0 v SD-PUBLISH 0 EXIT THEN
  v SD-DELAY SD-V@ DUP 0> IF
    1- DUP v SD-DELAY SD-V! 0= IF v SD-CONSUME THEN

binary_reuse.meaning: All332 native sources match prior verified baseline ReleaseFast binaries. No rebuild, native/Builtin/ABI changes.

dictionary_here_baseline.meaning: Logical HERE region only, not RSS, total allocator usage or native binary growth. Playback buffers allocated separately.

adoption.baseline_decision: Not sufficient for full declared real-time workload. Need optimization and, if still insufficient, native migration decision.
adoption.limits: Core-only, not CPU/ROM/device. Singlevoice passes but filter3/maxpitch fails bothOS and echo is marginal onWindows. No claim of underrun-free playback.
adoption.arshift_decision: All six improved, but maximum BRR is below real time on both OS. Implement separately reviewed native frame kernel1183; acceptance remains incomplete.

tasks_snapshot.title: 音源試作08 SNES S-DSP：資料/ライセンスと対象範囲を確定し、レジスタ/状態・8声/BRR・envelope/noise/echo等をForthで検証/測定、SPC700 CPUとは分けて本体移行の採否と未実装を記録
SNES01 仕様・Forth実装と独立検証：対象モデル/変種と宣言範囲を資料で確定、状態/時刻境界とPCMを別実装・手計算で照合しClaudeレビューと採否論点を記録
SNES Windows受け入れ：通常/機能除外構成の独立PCM/状態照合、サイズと速度・採否、Windows実装置での生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/版/装置を記録
SNES Linux受け入れ：通常/機能除外構成の独立PCM/状態照合、サイズと速度・採否、PulseAudio/ALSAでの生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/版/装置とWSL/実機の別を記録
SNES Mac受け入れ：Mac実機の通常/機能除外構成・独立PCM/状態照合・サイズと速度、生成音の実聴・Ctrl+C後の停止/再再生と資源回収を確認しOS/CPU/版/装置を記録。完了まで機種の親を未完了に維持

windows.scope: Declared S-DSP core only, not SPC700/ROM/device. Six16384frame stereo loads. Default no NTIME/CPUTIME calls. --measure7 fresh processes per load with rotated order; warmup/reset/fullARAM reset/A5/pre-state outside timing. Every fullPCM/266semantic state/queue2/fullARAM checked outside timing. Dense8kHz2events includes reg/ownedRAM byte enqueue and compaction checks; no pending entries moved. Wall primary may jump, CPUTIME reference may be quantized and2 calls included in wall. Linux is WSL2.

\ Original Forth-only synthesis workload for task999. NOT a hardware emulator.
\ Loading only defines words: it does not open audio or play anything.
\ 4 voices; Q24 phase; fixed 48000 Hz mono signed16 little-endian output.
DECIMAL
48000 CONSTANT PS-RATE
16777216 CONSTANT PS-TURN
CREATE PS-KIND 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-STEP 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-GAIN 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-DUTY 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-PHASE 4 CELLS ALLOT
CREATE PS-NOISE 4 CELLS ALLOT
: PS-AT ( voice base -- addr ) SWAP CELLS + ;
: PS-VOICE? ( voice -- ) 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN ;
: PS-RESET ( -- )
  4 0 DO
    0 I PS-KIND PS-AT ! 0 I PS-STEP PS-AT !
    0 I PS-GAIN PS-AT ! 128 I PS-DUTY PS-AT !
    0 I PS-PHASE PS-AT ! 1 I PS-NOISE PS-AT !
  LOOP ;
\ Write (value voice register): 0 kind(0mute/1pulse/2triangle/3noise),
\ 1 Hz(0..23999), 2 peak gain(0..8191), 3 pulse duty(1..255 /256).
\ Validate all arguments before changing state; other fields/phase stay intact.
: PS-REG! ( value voice register -- )
  OVER PS-VOICE?
  DUP 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
  DUP 0= IF DROP OVER 0 4 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-KIND PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER 0 24000 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN
    SWAP PS-TURN * PS-RATE / SWAP PS-STEP PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DUP 2 = IF DROP OVER 0 8192 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-GAIN PS-AT ! EXIT THEN
  DROP OVER 1 256 WITHIN 0= IF -24 THROW THEN PS-DUTY PS-AT ! ;
: PS-LFSR ( u -- u ) DUP DUP 1 RSHIFT XOR 1 AND 15 LSHIFT SWAP 1 RSHIFT OR ;
: PS-VOICE ( voice -- sample )
  DUP PS-PHASE PS-AT @ OVER PS-STEP PS-AT @ +
  DUP PS-TURN >= IF
    OVER PS-NOISE PS-AT DUP @ PS-LFSR SWAP !
  THEN
  PS-TURN 1- AND DUP 2 PICK PS-PHASE PS-AT !
  OVER PS-KIND PS-AT @
  DUP 0= IF DROP 2DROP 0 EXIT THEN
  DUP 1 = IF DROP OVER PS-DUTY PS-AT @ 65536 * <
    IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN EXIT THEN
  2 = IF
    14 RSHIFT DUP 512 < IF 128 * 32768 - ELSE 128 * 98304 SWAP - THEN
    SWAP PS-GAIN PS-AT @ * 32768 / EXIT THEN
  DROP DUP PS-NOISE PS-AT @ 1 AND IF PS-GAIN PS-AT @ ELSE PS-GAIN PS-AT @ NEGATE THEN ;
: PS-SAMPLE ( -- n ) 0 4 0 DO I PS-VOICE + LOOP ;
: PS-LE! ( n addr -- ) OVER 255 AND OVER C! SWAP 8 RSHIFT 255 AND SWAP 1+ C! ;
\ Caller supplies a valid destination of frames*2 bytes; no audio host needed.
: PS-RENDER ( addr frames -- ) DUP 0< IF -24 THROW THEN 0 ?DO PS-SAMPLE OVER PS-LE! 2 + LOOP DROP ;
: PS-DEMO-SETUP ( -- )
  PS-RESET
  1 0 0 PS-REG! 440 0 1 PS-REG! 2000 0 2 PS-REG! 64 0 3 PS-REG!
  1 1 0 PS-REG! 660 1 1 PS-REG! 2000 1 2 PS-REG!
  2 2 0 PS-REG! 110 2 1 PS-REG! 2000 2 2 PS-REG!
  3 3 0 PS-REG! 3000 3 1 PS-REG! 500 3 2 PS-REG! ;
PS-RESET

\ Explicit PCM playback wrapper for pcm-synth.fs. Loading does not play audio.
\ Run from repository root: sigma examples/pcm-synth-play.fs -e "PS-DEMO-SETUP 96 FALSE PS-STREAM BYE"
\ TRUE opts into audible output (start at low system volume).
S" examples/pcm-synth.fs" INCLUDED
REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO
CREATE PS-BUFFER 1024 ALLOT
VARIABLE PS-HANDLE
VARIABLE PS-BLOCKS
VARIABLE PS-AUDIBLE
VARIABLE PS-SENT
VARIABLE PS-REQUEST
VARIABLE PS-WRITES
VARIABLE PS-PARTIAL
VARIABLE PS-FULL
VARIABLE PS-WAITS
VARIABLE PS-FRAMES
VARIABLE PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT
: PS-SEND ( -- )
  0 PS-SENT !
  BEGIN 512 PS-SENT @ - DUP 0> WHILE
    DUP PS-REQUEST ! PS-BUFFER PS-SENT @ 2 * + SWAP PS-HANDLE @ PCM-WRITE THROW
    1 PS-WRITES +!
    DUP 0= IF 1 PS-FULL +! THEN
    DUP 0> IF DUP PS-REQUEST @ < IF 1 PS-PARTIAL +! THEN THEN
    DUP PS-FRAMES +! PS-SENT +!
    PS-SENT @ 512 < IF
      1 PS-WAITS +! 1 1000 PS-HANDLE @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN
    THEN
  REPEAT DROP ;
: PS-RUN ( -- )
  PS-RATE 1 4096 PCM-OPEN THROW PS-HANDLE !
  PS-BLOCKS @ 0 ?DO
    PS-BUFFER 512 PS-RENDER
    PS-AUDIBLE @ 0= IF PS-BUFFER 1024 0 FILL THEN
    PS-SEND
  LOOP
  1 1000 PS-HANDLE @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-HANDLE @ PCM-UNDERRUNS THROW PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT ! ;
\ Always attempt close after success/error. A failed close retains PS-HANDLE
\ for PS-CLEANUP retry; primary error wins if both body and cleanup fail.
: PS-CLEANUP ( -- ior )
  PS-HANDLE @ DUP 0= IF DROP 0 EXIT THEN
  PCM-CLOSE DUP 0= IF 0 PS-HANDLE ! THEN ;
: PS-SAFE-CLEANUP ( -- ior ) ['] PS-CLEANUP CATCH DUP IF EXIT THEN DROP ;
: PS-STREAM ( blocks audible -- )
  OVER 0< IF -24 THROW THEN
  PS-HANDLE @ IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-AUDIBLE ! PS-BLOCKS !
  0 PS-WRITES ! 0 PS-PARTIAL ! 0 PS-FULL ! 0 PS-WAITS !
  0 PS-FRAMES ! 0 PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT !
  ['] PS-RUN CATCH >R PS-SAFE-CLEANUP
  R> ?DUP IF SWAP DROP THROW THEN THROW ;

temporary_sources.acceptance.py:
"""Check/prepare S-DSP stereo fixtures; generated sound requires explicit --play."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import platform
import re
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
from pathlib import Path

if not __debug__:
    raise SystemExit('Do not use -O.')
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FOLDER = ROOT / '.work/1175-1176'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sd', ROOT / 'tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio.py')
sd = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(sd)
COMMON = (FOLDER / 'acceptance-common.fs').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
SOURCES = ['.work/1175-1176/acceptance.py', '.work/1175-1176/acceptance-common.fs',
           'examples/snes-dsp-audio-native-play.fs', 'examples/snes-dsp-audio-native.fs',
           'examples/snes-dsp-native-backend.fs', 'examples/snes-dsp-audio-play.fs',
           'examples/snes-dsp-audio.fs', 'examples/pcm-synth-play.fs', 'examples/pcm-synth.fs',
           'examples/snes-gauss.fs', 'tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio.py', 'scripts/snes-gauss-data.json']

def source_hashes():
    return {f: hashlib.sha256((ROOT/f).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')).hexdigest() for f in SOURCES}

def execution_ok(code, text, stderr):
    return (code == 0 and not stderr and
            len(re.findall(r'handle=\s*0\s+underruns=\s*0\s+frames=\s*98304', text)) == 2 and
            bool(re.search(r'DEPTH=\s*0', text)))

def note(pitch, left, right):
    model = sd.demo()
    for reg, value in [(108,32),(44,0),(60,0),(77,0),(2,pitch%256),(3,pitch//256),
                       (0,left),(1,right),(7,64),(76,1)]:
        model.store(value, reg)
    return model

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('os', choices=['windows','linux'])
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument('--play', action='store_true')
    mode.add_argument('--verify', action='store_true')
    mode.add_argument('--check-ready', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    binary = ROOT / f'.work/1183/matrix/{args.os}/bin' / ('sigma.exe' if args.os == 'windows' else 'sigma')
    verified = json.loads((ROOT/'docs/measurements/2026-11-20-snes-dsp-native.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    sha = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert sha == verified['binaries'][args.os]['sha256']
    hashes = source_hashes()
    if args.play or args.check_ready:
        proof = json.loads((FOLDER/f'{args.os}-stereo-preflight.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert proof['binary_sha256'] == sha and proof['source_sha256_lf'] == hashes
        assert proof['common_sha256_lf'] == hashlib.sha256(COMMON.encode()).hexdigest()
        assert len(proof['tests']) == 2 and all(t['full_PCM_state_ARAM_match'] and t['inactive_channel_all_zero'] for t in proof['tests'])
        silent = json.loads((FOLDER/f'{args.os}-stereo-silent.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert not silent['audible'] and silent['binary_sha256'] == sha

"""Channel diagnosis: raw440Hz PCM bypasses S-DSP. Silent unless --play."""
import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,json,re,struct,subprocess,tempfile,threading
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];WORK=ROOT/'.work/1175-1176/channel-check';WORK.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('accept',ROOT/'.work/1175-1176/acceptance.py');accept=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(accept)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode=parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group();mode.add_argument('--verify',action='store_true');mode.add_argument('--play',action='store_true');mode.add_argument('--check-ready',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    binary=ROOT/'.work/1183/matrix/windows/bin/sigma.exe';sha=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    record=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/measurements/2026-11-20-snes-dsp-native.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert sha==record['binaries']['windows']['sha256']
    assets={}
    for name,left,right in [('L',True,False),('R',False,True),('B',True,True)]:
        data=bytearray()
        for i in range(64000):
            phase=i*440%32000;sample=(32000-abs(2*phase-32000))*2*849//32000-849
            data.extend(struct.pack('<hh',sample if left else 0,sample if right else 0))
        path=WORK/(name+'.pcm');path.write_bytes(data);assets[name]=bytes(data)
    hashes=accept.source_hashes();hashes['.work/1175-1176/channel-check.py']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest()
    hashes.update({f'{name}.pcm':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() for name,data in assets.items()})
    if args.play or args.check_ready:
        for filename in ('preflight.json','silent.json'):
            proof=json.loads((WORK/filename).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert proof['binary_sha256']==sha and proof['source_sha256_lf_and_assets']==hashes and proof['checks_passed']
        if args.check_ready:print('Raw440Hz channel fixture ready; no playback.');return
    prefix=accept.COMMON+'''
CREATE RAW-L 256000 ALLOT CREATE RAW-R 256000 ALLOT CREATE RAW-B 256000 ALLOT
: RAW-LOAD { address path length | file -- }
  path length R/O OPEN-FILE THROW TO file
  address 256000 file READ-FILE THROW 256000 <> IF file CLOSE-FILE DROP -37 THROW THEN
  file CLOSE-FILE THROW ;
'''
    for name in assets:prefix+=f'RAW-{name} S" {(WORK/(name+".pcm")).as_posix()}" RAW-LOAD\n'
    if args.verify:
        output=WORK/'loaded.bin';code=prefix+f'S" {output.as_posix()}" W/O CREATE-FILE THROW CONSTANT RAW-FILE '
        code+=' '.join(f'RAW-{name} 256000 RAW-FILE WRITE-FILE THROW' for name in assets)+' RAW-FILE CLOSE-FILE THROW SD-FRAME @ . DEPTH . BYE\n'
        script=WORK/'verify.fs';script.write_text(code,encoding='utf-8');result=subprocess.run([str(binary),str(script)],capture_output=True,input=b'',timeout=20,cwd=ROOT)
        assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr and result.stdout.split()==[b'0',b'0'],(result.stdout,result.stderr)
        assert output.read_bytes()==b''.join(assets.values())
        report={'case':'raw440-channel-reference-preflight','binary_sha256':sha,'source_sha256_lf_and_assets':hashes,'checks_passed':True,'source':code,'bypasses_S_DSP_synthesis':True,'device_output':False,'peak_abs_s16':849,'frames_per_stage':64000,'channel_patterns':['L-only','R-only','L=R']}
        (WORK/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print('All loaded PCM bytes match; S-DSP frame remains0; no device output.');return
    body='''
VARIABLE RAW-ADDRESS
: RAW-BODY
  32000 2 4096 PCM-OPEN THROW PS-HANDLE !
  RAW-ADDRESS @ 4096 SD-SEND
  117 0 DO RAW-ADDRESS @ 4096 I 512 * + 4 * + 512 SD-SEND LOOP
  1 1000 PS-HANDLE @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-HANDLE @ PCM-UNDERRUNS THROW PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT ! ;
: RAW-PLAY
  PS-HANDLE @ IF -528 THROW THEN RAW-ADDRESS !
  0 PS-FRAMES ! 0 PS-WRITES ! 0 PS-PARTIAL ! 0 PS-FULL ! 0 PS-WAITS ! 0 PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT !
  ['] RAW-BODY CATCH >R PS-SAFE-CLEANUP R> ?DUP IF SWAP DROP THROW THEN THROW
  64000 SD-ACCEPT-DONE ;
'''
    code=prefix+body
    if not args.play:code+='RAW-L 256000 0 FILL RAW-R 256000 0 FILL RAW-B 256000 0 FILL\n'
    for label,name in [('LEFT','L'),('RIGHT','R'),('BOTH','B')]:code+=f'." RAW440 {label}: about2seconds" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW RAW-{name} RAW-PLAY 500 MS\n'
    code+=' ." S-DSP-FRAME=" SD-FRAME @ . ." DEPTH=" DEPTH . CR 250 MS BYE\n'
    tag='audible' if args.play else 'silent';script=WORK/(tag+'.fs');script.write_text(code,encoding='utf-8');lines=[];timed_out=False
    print('Raw440Hz: LEFT -> RIGHT -> BOTH,2seconds each '+('[AUDIBLE]' if args.play else '[ZEROS ONLY]'),flush=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as errors:
        with subprocess.Popen([str(binary),str(script)],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=errors,text=True,encoding='utf-8',bufsize=1) as proc:
            def read_lines():
                for line in proc.stdout:lines.append(line);print(line,end='',flush=True)
            reader=threading.Thread(target=read_lines,daemon=True);reader.start()
            try:proc.wait(timeout=30)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:timed_out=True;proc.kill();proc.wait()
            reader.join();status=proc.returncode
        errors.seek(0);stderr=errors.read().decode('utf-8')
    text=''.join(lines);ok=not timed_out and status==0 and not stderr and len(re.findall(r'handle=\s*0\s+underruns=\s*0\s+frames=\s*64000',text))==3 and bool(re.search(r'S-DSP-FRAME=\s*0\s+DEPTH=\s*0',text))
    report={'case':'raw440-channel-reference-'+tag,'binary_sha256':sha,'source_sha256_lf_and_assets':hashes,'checks_passed':ok,'source':code,'stdout':text,'stderr':stderr,'exit':status,'timeout':timed_out,'audible':args.play,'human_result':'pending' if args.play else 'not applicable; zeros only'}
    (WORK/(tag+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    if not ok:raise SystemExit('Channel reference failed; inspect saved record.')
if __name__=='__main__':main()

import importlib.util,json,hashlib,struct,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'.work/1175-1176'
def module(name,file):
 spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name,root/file);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m);return m
fixtures=module('fixtures','tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio-stream.py');sd=module('sd','tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio.py');accept=module('accept','.work/1175-1176/acceptance.py')
prefix=fixtures.PREFIX.split('S" examples/snes-dsp-audio-play.fs" INCLUDED',1)[0].replace('CREATE MC-ADDR 64 ALLOT CREATE MC-COPIED 24576 ALLOT','CREATE MC-ADDR 2048 ALLOT CREATE MC-COPIED 393216 ALLOT')
results=[]
for label,pitch,left,right in [('left-low',451,16,0),('right-high',901,0,16)]:
 model=accept.note(pitch,left,right);expected=model.render(98304)
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=folder,prefix='sent-capture-') as tmp:
  tmp=Path(tmp);pcm=tmp/'sent.bin';file=tmp/'fixture.fs'
  source=prefix+accept.COMMON+sd.DUMP+f'{pitch} {left} {right} SD-NOTE 192 TRUE SD-STREAM SNAP MC-COPIED-FRAMES @ . MC-CLOSES @ . PS-HANDLE @ . S" {pcm.as_posix()}" W/O CREATE-FILE THROW CONSTANT PF MC-COPIED 393216 PF WRITE-FILE THROW PF CLOSE-FILE THROW DEPTH . BYE\n'
  file.write_text(source,encoding='utf-8');q=subprocess.run(['.work/1183/matrix/windows/bin/sigma.exe',str(file)],capture_output=True,input=b'',timeout=30)
  assert q.returncode==0 and not q.stderr,(q.stdout[:1000],q.stderr)
  lines=[line for line in q.stdout.decode().splitlines() if not line.startswith('WARNING:')];values=list(map(int,' '.join(lines).split()))
  assert values==model.state()+[0,0,98304,1,0,0],values[-8:]
  captured=pcm.read_bytes();assert captured==expected
  samples=struct.unpack('<196608h',captured)
  results.append({'case':label,'source':source,'capture_is_RAM_callback_not_physical_output':True,'entire_98304_frame_stream_matches_independent_python':True,'left_nonzero_samples':sum(x!=0 for x in samples[::2]),'right_nonzero_samples':sum(x!=0 for x in samples[1::2]),'left_peak':max(map(abs,samples[::2])),'right_peak':max(map(abs,samples[1::2])),'pcm_sha256':hashlib.sha256(captured).hexdigest()})
audition=json.loads((folder/'windows-stereo-audible.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
binary_sha=hashlib.sha256((root/'.work/1183/matrix/windows/bin/sigma.exe').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert binary_sha==audition['binary_sha256']
source_hashes=accept.source_hashes()
for f,h in audition['source_sha256_lf'].items():assert source_hashes[f]==h,f
source_hashes['.work/1175-1176/capture-sent.py']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest()
source_hashes['tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio-stream.py']=hashlib.sha256((root/'tests/scripts/verify-snes-dsp-audio-stream.py').read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest()
for result in results:
 result['binary_sha256']=binary_sha
 result['source_sha256_lf']=source_hashes
 result['relation_to_audition']='Same binary and included source hashes; PCM words replaced with RAM callbacks. This does not validate the Zig transport or physical output.'
(folder/'windows-stereo-sent-capture.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps([{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='source'} for r in results],indent=2))

"""Recheck only original SNES low-left tone; silent without explicit --play."""
import argparse,hashlib,importlib.util,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];FOLDER=ROOT/'.work/1175-1176'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('accept',FOLDER/'acceptance.py');accept=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(accept)
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--play',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    binary=ROOT/'.work/1183/matrix/windows/bin/sigma.exe';sha=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    proof=json.loads((FOLDER/'windows-stereo-preflight.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    hashes=accept.source_hashes();assert proof['binary_sha256']==sha and proof['source_sha256_lf']==hashes
    assert proof['common_sha256_lf']==hashlib.sha256(accept.COMMON.encode()).hexdigest()
    left=next(t for t in proof['tests'] if t['case']=='left-low');assert left['full_PCM_state_ARAM_match'] and left['inactive_channel_all_zero']
    capture=json.loads((FOLDER/'windows-stereo-sent-capture.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))[0]
    assert capture['binary_sha256']==sha and capture['pcm_sha256']==left['pcm_sha256'] and capture['right_nonzero_samples']==0
    hashes['.work/1175-1176/left-recheck.py']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest()
    if args.play:
        silent=json.loads((FOLDER/'windows-left-recheck-silent.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        assert silent['binary_sha256']==sha and silent['source_sha256_lf']==hashes and silent['execution_checks_passed'] and not silent['audible']
    tag='audible' if args.play else 'silent';audible='TRUE' if args.play else 'FALSE'
    code=accept.COMMON+f''' ." READY: original SNES left-low after1second" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW
1000 MS 451 16 0 SD-NOTE 192 {audible} SD-STREAM 98304 SD-ACCEPT-DONE
." DEPTH=" DEPTH . CR 250 MS BYE
'''
    path=FOLDER/f'windows-left-recheck-{tag}.fs';path.write_text(code,encoding='utf-8')
    print('After1second, original SNES low tone LEFT ONLY ~3seconds '+('[AUDIBLE]' if args.play else '[ZEROS ONLY]'),flush=True)

    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:

    report={'case':'original-snes-low-left-recheck-'+tag,'binary_sha256':sha,'source_sha256_lf':hashes,'source':code,'audible':args.play,'execution_checks_passed':ok,'stdout':text,'stderr':stderr,'exit':status,'timeout':timed_out,'human_result':'pending' if args.play else 'not applicable; zeros only','expected_PCM_sha256':left['pcm_sha256'],'relation_to_initial_test':'Same451/16/0 setup and192x512frames. Only isolated to one stage with1second lead-in; tone level and synthesis unchanged.'}
    (FOLDER/f'windows-left-recheck-{tag}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare/run owned PCM acceptance cases; silent unless --audible is explicit.

Run from a foreground terminal for case8 (physical Ctrl+C and hello input).
The JSON records execution only; a human must separately report what was heard.
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CASES = {
    1: '48000Hz mono 440Hz, 2 seconds',
    2: '22050Hz stereo: left 440Hz then right 660Hz, 1.5 seconds each',
    3: '48000Hz mono 220Hz mixed with MML melody',
    4: '48000Hz mono 220Hz mixed with signed-8-bit SFX 880Hz',
    5: 'queued PCM discard after150ms, 1 second pause, reopen and restart',
    6: 'PCM drain followed by DRAINED, silence after completion',
    7: 'SAVESYS app plays523Hz then784Hz, each1second',
    8: 'continuous550Hz; physical Ctrl+C during PCM-WAIT, then type hello',
}


def triangle(rate, hz, index, amplitude):
    phase = index * hz % rate
    return (rate - abs(2 * phase - rate)) * 2 * amplitude // rate - amplitude


def prepare(folder, case, audible):
    if any(c in folder.as_posix() for c in ['"', '\n', '\r']):
        raise ValueError('Forth S" paths cannot contain quotes or line breaks')
    if case == 7 and any(c.isspace() for c in folder.as_posix()):
        raise ValueError('SAVESYS acceptance requires a repository path without whitespace')
    rate = 22050 if case == 2 else 48000
    channels = 2 if case == 2 else 1
    frames = rate * (3 if case == 2 else 2)
    amplitude = 4096 if audible else 0
    data = bytearray()
    for i in range(frames):
        hz = 440 if case in [1, 2, 5, 6] else 220 if case in [3, 4] else (523 if i < rate else 784) if case == 7 else 550
        if channels == 2:
            left = i < rate * 3 // 2
            value = triangle(rate, 440 if left else 660, i, amplitude)
            data.extend(struct.pack('<hh', value if left else 0, 0 if left else value))
        else:
            data.extend(struct.pack('<h', triangle(rate, hz, i, amplitude)))
    pcm = folder / 'input.pcm'
    pcm.write_bytes(data)
    common = f'''REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO
CREATE BUF {len(data)} ALLOT
S" {pcm.as_posix()}" R/O OPEN-FILE THROW CONSTANT FD
BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN
FD CLOSE-FILE THROW
VARIABLE P VARIABLE OFFSET VARIABLE SENT VARIABLE REQUEST VARIABLE WRITES
: OPEN-PCM {rate} {channels} {32768 if rate == 48000 else 16384} PCM-OPEN THROW P ! ;
: CLEANUP P @ DUP IF PCM-CLOSE DUP 0= IF 0 P ! THEN ELSE DROP 0 THEN ;
: SEND ( frames -- )
  0 SENT ! BEGIN DUP SENT @ > WHILE
    DUP SENT @ - 512 MIN REQUEST !
    BUF OFFSET @ {channels * 2} * + REQUEST @ P @ PCM-WRITE THROW
    DUP SENT +! OFFSET +! 1 WRITES +!
    DUP SENT @ > IF 1 1000 P @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN THEN
  REPEAT DROP ;
: DRAIN 1 3000 P @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN ." DRAINED" CR ;
: REPORT ." UNDERRUNS=" P @ PCM-UNDERRUNS THROW .
  ." WRITES=" WRITES @ . CR ;
: TONE 0 OFFSET ! {frames} SEND ;
'''
    # Keep the file-size guard inside a definition: IF is compile-only.
    common = common.replace(f'BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN',
                            f': LOAD-PCM BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN ; LOAD-PCM')
    extra = ''
    if case == 4:
        sfx = bytes((triangle(48000, 880, i, 24 if audible else 0) & 255) for i in range(48000))
        sample = folder / 'sfx.raw'; sample.write_bytes(sfx)
        extra = f'''CREATE FX 48000 ALLOT
S" {sample.as_posix()}" R/O OPEN-FILE THROW CONSTANT FXFD
: LOAD-FX FX 48000 FXFD READ-FILE THROW 48000 <> IF -37 THROW THEN ; LOAD-FX
FXFD CLOSE-FILE THROW FX 48000 48000 0 SAMPLE
'''
    if case == 5:
        body = 'OPEN-PCM 0 OFFSET ! 32768 SEND 150 MS 0 1000 P @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN ." DISCARDED" CR CLEANUP THROW 1000 MS OPEN-PCM TONE DRAIN REPORT 250 MS'
    elif case == 8:
        # 4800 frames contain exactly55 periods at550Hz/48000Hz. Repeating
        # this block preserves phase; wait for one block of space, not empty.
        body = 'OPEN-PCM EKEY? DROP ." READY: Ctrl+C during PCM-WAIT; then type hello" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW BEGIN 0 OFFSET ! 4800 SEND 4800 -1 P @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN AGAIN'
    else:
        mix = ('S" T120 O5 L8 CEG>C<GE" PLAY ' if audible else '') if case == 3 else ('0 SFX ' if case == 4 else '')
        body = 'OPEN-PCM ' + mix + 'TONE DRAIN REPORT ' + ('1000 MS' if case == 6 else '250 MS')
    source = common + extra + ': BODY ' + body + ' ;\n'
    source += ': RUN [\'] BODY CATCH >R [\'] CLEANUP CATCH DUP IF ELSE DROP THEN R> ?DUP IF SWAP DROP THROW THEN THROW ;\n'
    if case == 7:
        app = folder / ('pcm-saved.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'pcm-saved')
        source += ': MAIN RUN ; \' MAIN APP-ENTRY! SAVESYS ' + app.as_posix() + ' BYE\n'
    elif case == 8:
        source += "' BODY CATCH .\" CATCH=\" . CLEANUP .\" CLOSE=\" . CR CREATE LINE 64 ALLOT LINE 64 ACCEPT . CR LINE SWAP TYPE CR BYE\n"
        # ACCEPT's count is needed for TYPE; retain it when printing.
        source = source.replace('LINE 64 ACCEPT . CR LINE SWAP TYPE', 'LINE 64 ACCEPT DUP . CR LINE SWAP TYPE')
    else:
        source += 'RUN ." COMPLETE DEPTH=" DEPTH . CR BYE\n'
    script = folder / 'listen.fs'; script.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    return script, source, data


@contextlib.contextmanager
def parent_sigint_guard():
    # A caught (rather than SIG_IGN) handler resets to default across POSIX
    # exec. Sigma installs its own wait handler. Only the Python parent keeps
    # this no-op, so Ctrl+C can reach Sigma without aborting the supervisor.
    previous = signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda signum, frame: None)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, previous)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('sigma', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--case', type=int, choices=CASES, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--audible', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--record', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    binary = args.sigma.resolve()
    work = ROOT / '.work/998-followup'; work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='listen-', dir=work) as tmp:
        folder = Path(tmp); script, source, data = prepare(folder, args.case, args.audible)
        print(CASES[args.case] + (' [AUDIBLE]' if args.audible else ' [SILENT]'), flush=True)
        if args.audible:
            probe = subprocess.run([str(binary), '-e', 'REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO AUDIO? . BYE'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            if probe.returncode or probe.stderr or probe.stdout.split() != ['-1']:
                raise RuntimeError('AUDIO? is not true; no device audition attempted: ' + repr(probe.stdout))
        start = time.monotonic()
        if args.case == 8:
            # Inherit physical stdin; tee stdout for both user and evidence.
            with parent_sigint_guard():
                with subprocess.Popen([str(binary), str(script)], cwd=ROOT,
                                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                      text=True, encoding='utf-8', bufsize=1) as result:
                    lines = []
                    for line in result.stdout:
                        print(line, end='', flush=True); lines.append(line)
                    result.wait()
            stdout = ''.join(lines); stderr = None
            if not re.search(r'CATCH=\s*-28\s+CLOSE=\s*0[\s\S]*5\s+hello\s*$', stdout):
                raise RuntimeError('Interruption/cleanup/hello did not match: ' + repr(stdout))
        else:
            result = subprocess.run([str(binary), str(script)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=25)
            stdout, stderr = result.stdout, result.stderr
            if result.returncode or stderr:
                raise RuntimeError((result.returncode, stdout, stderr))
            if args.case == 7:
                app = folder / ('pcm-saved.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'pcm-saved')
                saved = subprocess.run([str(app)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=25)
                if saved.returncode or saved.stderr or 'DRAINED' not in saved.stdout:
                    raise RuntimeError((saved.returncode, saved.stdout, saved.stderr))
                stdout += saved.stdout
            elif 'COMPLETE DEPTH=0' not in stdout or 'DRAINED' not in stdout:
                raise RuntimeError(stdout)
            if args.case == 5 and 'DISCARDED' not in stdout:
                raise RuntimeError('Discard acknowledgement missing: ' + stdout)
            print(stdout, end='')
        report = {'case': args.case, 'description': CASES[args.case], 'audible_requested': args.audible,
                  'human_listening_result': 'not recorded; requires user confirmation',
                  'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'pcm_sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'pcm_bytes': len(data),
                  'source': source, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr,
                  'underruns': [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'UNDERRUNS=\s*(\d+)', stdout or '')],
                  'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start}
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(report)
        if args.record:
            args.record.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            args.record.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare/run owned PCM acceptance cases; silent unless --audible is explicit.

Run from a foreground terminal for case8 (physical Ctrl+C and hello input).
The JSON records execution only; a human must separately report what was heard.
"""
import argparse
import contextlib
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
CASES = {
    1: '48000Hz mono 440Hz, 2 seconds',
    2: '22050Hz stereo: left 440Hz then right 660Hz, 1.5 seconds each',
    3: '48000Hz mono 220Hz mixed with MML melody',
    4: '48000Hz mono 220Hz mixed with signed-8-bit SFX 880Hz',
    5: 'queued PCM discard after150ms, 1 second pause, reopen and restart',
    6: 'PCM drain followed by DRAINED, silence after completion',
    7: 'SAVESYS app plays523Hz then784Hz, each1second',
    8: 'continuous550Hz; physical Ctrl+C during PCM-WAIT, then type hello',
}


def triangle(rate, hz, index, amplitude):
    phase = index * hz % rate
    return (rate - abs(2 * phase - rate)) * 2 * amplitude // rate - amplitude


def prepare(folder, case, audible):
    if any(c in folder.as_posix() for c in ['"', '\n', '\r']):
        raise ValueError('Forth S" paths cannot contain quotes or line breaks')
    if case == 7 and any(c.isspace() for c in folder.as_posix()):
        raise ValueError('SAVESYS acceptance requires a repository path without whitespace')
    rate = 22050 if case == 2 else 48000
    channels = 2 if case == 2 else 1
    frames = rate * (3 if case == 2 else 2)
    amplitude = 4096 if audible else 0
    data = bytearray()
    for i in range(frames):
        hz = 440 if case in [1, 2, 5, 6] else 220 if case in [3, 4] else (523 if i < rate else 784) if case == 7 else 550
        if channels == 2:
            left = i < rate * 3 // 2
            value = triangle(rate, 440 if left else 660, i, amplitude)
            data.extend(struct.pack('<hh', value if left else 0, 0 if left else value))
        else:
            data.extend(struct.pack('<h', triangle(rate, hz, i, amplitude)))
    pcm = folder / 'input.pcm'
    pcm.write_bytes(data)
    common = f'''REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO
CREATE BUF {len(data)} ALLOT
S" {pcm.as_posix()}" R/O OPEN-FILE THROW CONSTANT FD
BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN
FD CLOSE-FILE THROW
VARIABLE P VARIABLE OFFSET VARIABLE SENT VARIABLE REQUEST VARIABLE WRITES
: OPEN-PCM {rate} {channels} {32768 if rate == 48000 else 16384} PCM-OPEN THROW P ! ;
: CLEANUP P @ DUP IF PCM-CLOSE DUP 0= IF 0 P ! THEN ELSE DROP 0 THEN ;
: SEND ( frames -- )
  0 SENT ! BEGIN DUP SENT @ > WHILE
    DUP SENT @ - 512 MIN REQUEST !
    BUF OFFSET @ {channels * 2} * + REQUEST @ P @ PCM-WRITE THROW
    DUP SENT +! OFFSET +! 1 WRITES +!
    DUP SENT @ > IF 1 1000 P @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN THEN
  REPEAT DROP ;
: DRAIN 1 3000 P @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN ." DRAINED" CR ;
: REPORT ." UNDERRUNS=" P @ PCM-UNDERRUNS THROW .
  ." WRITES=" WRITES @ . CR ;
: TONE 0 OFFSET ! {frames} SEND ;
'''
    # Keep the file-size guard inside a definition: IF is compile-only.
    common = common.replace(f'BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN',
                            f': LOAD-PCM BUF {len(data)} FD READ-FILE THROW {len(data)} <> IF -37 THROW THEN ; LOAD-PCM')
    extra = ''
    if case == 4:
        sfx = bytes((triangle(48000, 880, i, 24 if audible else 0) & 255) for i in range(48000))
        sample = folder / 'sfx.raw'; sample.write_bytes(sfx)
        extra = f'''CREATE FX 48000 ALLOT
S" {sample.as_posix()}" R/O OPEN-FILE THROW CONSTANT FXFD
: LOAD-FX FX 48000 FXFD READ-FILE THROW 48000 <> IF -37 THROW THEN ; LOAD-FX
FXFD CLOSE-FILE THROW FX 48000 48000 0 SAMPLE
'''
    if case == 5:
        body = 'OPEN-PCM 0 OFFSET ! 32768 SEND 150 MS 0 1000 P @ PCM-STOP THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN ." DISCARDED" CR CLEANUP THROW 1000 MS OPEN-PCM TONE DRAIN REPORT 250 MS'
    elif case == 8:
        # 4800 frames contain exactly55 periods at550Hz/48000Hz. Repeating
        # this block preserves phase; wait for one block of space, not empty.
        body = 'OPEN-PCM EKEY? DROP ." READY: Ctrl+C during PCM-WAIT; then type hello" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW BEGIN 0 OFFSET ! 4800 SEND 4800 -1 P @ PCM-WAIT THROW 0= IF -528 THROW THEN AGAIN'
    else:
        mix = ('S" T120 O5 L8 CEG>C<GE" PLAY ' if audible else '') if case == 3 else ('0 SFX ' if case == 4 else '')
        body = 'OPEN-PCM ' + mix + 'TONE DRAIN REPORT ' + ('1000 MS' if case == 6 else '250 MS')
    source = common + extra + ': BODY ' + body + ' ;\n'
    source += ': RUN [\'] BODY CATCH >R [\'] CLEANUP CATCH DUP IF ELSE DROP THEN R> ?DUP IF SWAP DROP THROW THEN THROW ;\n'
    if case == 7:
        app = folder / ('pcm-saved.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'pcm-saved')
        source += ': MAIN RUN ; \' MAIN APP-ENTRY! SAVESYS ' + app.as_posix() + ' BYE\n'
    elif case == 8:
        source += "' BODY CATCH .\" CATCH=\" . CLEANUP .\" CLOSE=\" . CR CREATE LINE 64 ALLOT LINE 64 ACCEPT . CR LINE SWAP TYPE CR BYE\n"
        # ACCEPT's count is needed for TYPE; retain it when printing.
        source = source.replace('LINE 64 ACCEPT . CR LINE SWAP TYPE', 'LINE 64 ACCEPT DUP . CR LINE SWAP TYPE')
    else:
        source += 'RUN ." COMPLETE DEPTH=" DEPTH . CR BYE\n'
    script = folder / 'listen.fs'; script.write_text(source, encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    return script, source, data


@contextlib.contextmanager
def parent_sigint_guard():
    # A caught (rather than SIG_IGN) handler resets to default across POSIX
    # exec. Sigma installs its own wait handler. Only the Python parent keeps
    # this no-op, so Ctrl+C can reach Sigma without aborting the supervisor.
    previous = signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, lambda signum, frame: None)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, previous)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('sigma', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--case', type=int, choices=CASES, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--audible', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--record', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    binary = args.sigma.resolve()
    work = ROOT / '.work/998-followup'; work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='listen-', dir=work) as tmp:
        folder = Path(tmp); script, source, data = prepare(folder, args.case, args.audible)
        print(CASES[args.case] + (' [AUDIBLE]' if args.audible else ' [SILENT]'), flush=True)
        if args.audible:
            probe = subprocess.run([str(binary), '-e', 'REQUIRE-AUDIO ALSO AUDIO AUDIO? . BYE'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
            if probe.returncode or probe.stderr or probe.stdout.split() != ['-1']:
                raise RuntimeError('AUDIO? is not true; no device audition attempted: ' + repr(probe.stdout))
        start = time.monotonic()
        if args.case == 8:
            # Inherit physical stdin; tee stdout for both user and evidence.
            with parent_sigint_guard():
                with subprocess.Popen([str(binary), str(script)], cwd=ROOT,
                                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                      text=True, encoding='utf-8', bufsize=1) as result:
                    lines = []
                    for line in result.stdout:
                        print(line, end='', flush=True); lines.append(line)
                    result.wait()
            stdout = ''.join(lines); stderr = None
            if not re.search(r'CATCH=\s*-28\s+CLOSE=\s*0[\s\S]*5\s+hello\s*$', stdout):
                raise RuntimeError('Interruption/cleanup/hello did not match: ' + repr(stdout))
        else:
            result = subprocess.run([str(binary), str(script)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=25)
            stdout, stderr = result.stdout, result.stderr
            if result.returncode or stderr:
                raise RuntimeError((result.returncode, stdout, stderr))
            if args.case == 7:
                app = folder / ('pcm-saved.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'pcm-saved')
                saved = subprocess.run([str(app)], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=25)
                if saved.returncode or saved.stderr or 'DRAINED' not in saved.stdout:
                    raise RuntimeError((saved.returncode, saved.stdout, saved.stderr))
                stdout += saved.stdout
            elif 'COMPLETE DEPTH=0' not in stdout or 'DRAINED' not in stdout:
                raise RuntimeError(stdout)
            if args.case == 5 and 'DISCARDED' not in stdout:
                raise RuntimeError('Discard acknowledgement missing: ' + stdout)
            print(stdout, end='')
        report = {'case': args.case, 'description': CASES[args.case], 'audible_requested': args.audible,
                  'human_listening_result': 'not recorded; requires user confirmation',
                  'binary_sha256': hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                  'pcm_sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), 'pcm_bytes': len(data),
                  'source': source, 'exit': result.returncode, 'stdout': stdout, 'stderr': stderr,
                  'underruns': [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'UNDERRUNS=\s*(\d+)', stdout or '')],
                  'elapsed_seconds': time.monotonic() - start}
        if result.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(report)
        if args.record:
            args.record.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            args.record.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

device_checked_zero.helper_source:
"""Zero-only Linux device proof with complete file-backed stdout capture."""
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os,re,subprocess,sys,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd();folder=ROOT/'.work/1175-1176'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('accept',folder/'acceptance.py');accept=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(accept)
binary=ROOT/'.work/1183/matrix/linux/bin/sigma'
verified=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/measurements/2026-11-20-snes-dsp-native.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==verified['binaries']['linux']['sha256']
readiness=[]
for attempt in range(20):
    info=subprocess.run(['pactl','info'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
    log=Path('/mnt/wslg/pulseaudio.log');logtext=log.read_text(errors='replace') if log.exists() else ''
    ready=Path('/mnt/wslg/PulseServer').exists() and info.returncode==0 and 'RDP Sink - Connected to fd' in logtext
    readiness.append({'attempt':attempt+1,'socket_exists':Path('/mnt/wslg/PulseServer').exists(),'pactl_exit':info.returncode,'pactl_stderr':info.stderr,'RDP_connection_seen':bool('RDP Sink - Connected to fd' in logtext)})
    if ready:break
    time.sleep(.5)
else:
    (folder/'linux-zero-readiness-failed.json').write_text(json.dumps(readiness,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');raise SystemExit('WSLg route not ready; no fixture started.')
common=accept.COMMON
silent=json.loads((folder/'linux-stereo-silent.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
original=(folder/'linux-stereo-silent.fs').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert silent['execution_checks_passed'] and not silent['audible'] and original==silent['source'] and silent['source_sha256_lf']==accept.source_hashes()
assert original.startswith(common) and original.count('192 FALSE SD-STREAM')==2
body=original[len(common):]
guard=': CHECK-DEVICE AUDIO? DUP ." AUDIO?=" . CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW 0= IF -275 THROW THEN ; CHECK-DEVICE\n'
source=common+guard+body.replace('." DEPTH="','CHECK-DEVICE ." DEPTH="')
path=folder/'linux-device-checked-zero.fs';path.write_text(source,encoding='utf-8')
links=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output,tempfile.TemporaryFile() as errors:
    with subprocess.Popen([str(binary),str(path)],cwd=ROOT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=output,stderr=errors) as proc:
        sigma_pid=proc.pid
        time.sleep(1)  # Coordinate a route snapshot during the zero-only test, not performance measurement.
        pulse=subprocess.run(['pactl','list','sink-inputs'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        for token in re.findall(r'application\.process\.id\s*=\s*"(\d+)"',pulse.stdout):
            pid=int(token);status_path=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/status');cmd_path=Path(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline')
            if status_path.exists() and cmd_path.exists():
                status_text=status_path.read_text();ppid=int(re.search(r'^PPid:\s*(\d+)',status_text,re.M)[1])
                links.append({'pid':pid,'ppid':ppid,'cmdline':cmd_path.read_bytes().decode().replace(chr(0),' '),'parent_is_fixture_sigma':ppid==sigma_pid})
        try:proc.wait(timeout=25)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        exit_code=proc.returncode
    output.seek(0);text=output.read().decode('utf-8');errors.seek(0);stderr=errors.read().decode('utf-8')
ok=exit_code==0 and not stderr and text.count('AUDIO?=-1')==2 and text.count('LEFT LOW: about3seconds')==1 and text.count('RIGHT HIGH: about3seconds')==1 and text.count('handle=0 underruns=0 frames=98304')==2 and 'DEPTH=0' in text and pulse.returncode==0 and any(x['parent_is_fixture_sigma'] for x in links)
clean_pulse='\n'.join(line for line in pulse.stdout.splitlines() if not any(x in line for x in ('application.process.machine_id','application.process.user','application.process.host')))
report={'case':'Linux zero-only same-process device proof, complete file-backed transcript','helper_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),'helper_sha256_lf':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest(),'source':source,'source_sha256_lf':accept.source_hashes(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'stdout':text,'stderr':stderr,'exit':exit_code,'device_checks_passed':ok,'readiness_observations':readiness,'sigma_pid':sigma_pid,'pulse_pid_links':links,'active_pulse_inputs':clean_pulse,'pulse_query_stderr':pulse.stderr,'pulse_query_exit':pulse.returncode,'generated_audio':False,'capture_method':'All child stdout redirected to one temporary file and read after exit; no mixing readline with communicate.'}
(folder/'linux-device-checked-zero.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(text,end='');print(json.dumps(links))
if not ok:sys.exit(1)
